summary.text: Ryan Dvorak is a Democratic state representative from Indiana House District 8 who has represented the district since 2002 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a communications consultant and has previously served as assistant minority floor leader.
The other candidate on the general election ballot is Eric Harris, the Republican nominee.

paragraphs.text: Dvorak earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Notre Dame in 1996 and a law degree from the Indiana University School of Law in Indianapolis in 2008.
His professional experience includes working as a communications consultant, as a senior aide to Congressman Tim Roemer and as a substitute teacher.
He took office in the Indiana House in 2002 and previously served as assistant minority floor leader.
